name: Honda CB750 DOHC
engine: 749 cc air-cooled DOHC 16-valve inline four, four carbs
intro: The twin-cam CB750 that replaced the SOHC. The primary chain tensioner and the cam chain tensioner are the parts to check.

add.title: Listen for a knock low in the engine
add.instructions: Start it cold and listen near the starter motor area. A knock there can be a worn primary chain tensioner. Drop the oil pan and look for pieces of the tensioner wheels.
add.reason: Worn primary chain tensioners are a known DOHC CB750 problem, and the parts are hard to find new.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Primary chain tensioner
known.what: Owners report knocking near the starter from a worn primary chain tensioner. Parts are no longer sold by Honda.
